code:
Primary database
  |-- redo transport (SYNC or ASYNC) -->  Standby #1 (local)
  |-- redo transport (SYNC or ASYNC) -->  Standby #2 (remote DR)

No shared quorum. No WSFC underneath.
Each standby is a full, separate database
kept current by redo transport + redo apply.
caption: Same purpose as an AG. Different architecture underneath.

code:
-- Switchover: planned, no data loss, both
-- databases end healthy, roles reversed
ALTER DATABASE COMMIT TO SWITCHOVER TO STANDBY;

-- Failover: primary is actually gone,
-- a standby is promoted out of necessity
ALTER DATABASE ACTIVATE STANDBY DATABASE;

-- Fast-Start Failover: opt-in automatic
-- failover via an Observer process
caption: Switchover is a drill. Failover is the emergency.
